name: Surface, border and text colors come from the provided token palette
description: Surface, border and text colors come from the provided token palette.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / in dark mode and inspect the computed background of the main surfaces and the primary accent color

Verify colors come from the Matchday token palette: the dark surface is a neutral near-black (≈ #131313–#323232) and the primary/brand accent is the token green (≈ #54B365). Generic default colors (pure #000/#fff body, unstyled blue links) indicate the tokens were not adopted and fail.
